capabilities: define reusable note types (fileClasses) with typed fields and inheritance
fill frontmatter fields through guided input such as dropdowns, date pickers and link autocomplete
validate notes for missing or wrong-typed fields
generate editable Bases table views from a class
draw a schema canvas showing class inheritance and field bindings
disambiguation: Not a file organizer or classifier; it defines typed frontmatter schemas for notes, not file management.
extras: Full documentation and a 44-video feature tour live outside the README; the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README warns not to run it alongside Metadata Menu, which is in maintenance mode.
intentEvidence: It is the successor to Metadata Menu (same author).
motivation: The author rebuilt Metadata Menu around Obsidian's core Bases query engine to remove the Dataview dependency from field values and filtering.
problem: Obsidian frontmatter is free-form, so nothing enforces field types, allowed values, or required properties, and filling properties in by hand is error-prone.

relations.evidence: It is the successor to Metadata Menu (same author).

summary: Schema plugin that defines reusable note types with typed, validated frontmatter fields and guided input, built on the core Bases plugin.
